title: Saul on the road to Damascus blinded by an orb
plain: The light that blinded Saul on the road to Damascus, in the Bible's Book of Acts, was an orb: a glowing ball of light, the kind of thing UFO witnesses describe. Chris Bledsoe, a North Carolina man who says he has had many encounters with such lights, tells Michels this as his own reading of the passage. Acts tells of a light from heaven that strikes Saul down and leaves him blind, and Bledsoe sees the same thing in it that he says he has seen himself, though the text itself speaks only of a light.
